About Ksenia

Ksenia runs paid media for Yango Play, a streaming platform with exclusive and original Arabic content. Launched just two years ago, it has grown past 5 million Google Play downloads and reached #2 among top grossing entertainment Android apps in Egypt. Her job is to turn product, content and commercial priorities into media plans across social, search, video, CTV, programmatic, affiliates and offline, then prove what actually worked.

Before Yango Play, she spent 10+ years with Publicis Media. She grew from performance manager to Paid Social & Programmatic Director, building and leading a team of 30+ specialists, and then expanding into a Regional Media Strategy Director role. Along the way she advised Visa, Commercial Bank of Dubai, Samsung, LVMH, NEOM and Accor, and wrote go to market playbooks used across MENA, Europe, APAC and North America.

She cares most about measurement you can trust (incrementality, MMM, brand lift) and about using AI to make creative testing faster and cheaper. Today she is based between the UK and the UAE. She studied journalism at Lomonosov Moscow State University and graduated with a Diploma of Excellence, which may explain why she likes a good story behind the numbers.

Quick answers

Who is Ksenia Alekseeva?

Ksenia Alekseeva is an international media and growth marketing leader with 12+ years in B2C acquisition, experimentation and measurement. She is Head of Paid Media at Yango Play, a MENA streaming platform, and previously led paid social and programmatic at Publicis Media, working with Visa, Samsung, LVMH, Sephora, Commercial Bank of Dubai, NEOM and Accor.

Where is she based?

Between the UK and the UAE. Her work has covered MENA, Europe, APAC and North America, including global go to market playbooks for NEOM and Accor.

What does she do at Yango Play?

She leads media investment across digital and offline channels, owns the growth and launch roadmap, runs experimentation and measurement, and built AI creative production frameworks that generate 100+ assets per title. She has helped scale Yango Play to 5M+ Google Play downloads.

What awards has she won?

Her Yango Play work won two categories at the TikTok Ad Awards 2025, Sound On Please and Big Branding Energy. She also judges the Effie Awards and was named one of the top 10 talents in MENA in the TikTok Certification beta test.

Does she speak at events?

Yes. She has moderated at NXT Media Days MENA, joined Next Audio's Power of Podcasts panels, presented at TikTok Summit, the Yango CMO Summit, an IAB growth event and Kazan Digital Forum, and hosts her own podcast, This wasn't in the manual.

What is she like away from work?

Mostly in or near water. She surfs, windsurfs, wakesurfs and dives, plays tennis and padel, runs, and has travelled to more than 30 countries.

Talks, panels, podcasts or a good growth problem? Say hello.
